comparison_source.network: private unshare user/network namespace; no interfaces configured
comparison_source.scope: WSL controlled comparison; fixed preread archives, fresh private DB per run, copies of fixed seed; timing excludes verification; not production hardware or production latency

final_source.scope: Binary built from the listed source hashes and index tree, including the setup-retry fix.

scope: WSL comparison with fixed pre-read archives, one fresh private output per run, and rotated variant order. Logical CPU affinity 18/19 and imports in a private network namespace. Other workstation activity was not globally stopped. Not production latency or a cold-cache comparison.
timing_scope: Import timing includes DB initialization, all archives and final index/PRAGMA restoration, excluding seed copy and verification. Whole-process wall/CPU includes seed copy. Final-binary samples verify equivalence, not repeated performance.

fresh_batch_2_wall_outlier.status: Retained without adjustment; cause unproven. No matching Windows sleep/resume events in the checked interval.

daily_fixture_scope: Synthetic replay workload selected deterministically from the fixed weekly archives, preserving record order and related records. Not observed production daily inputs. Daily source-metadata behavior is covered by CLI/library regression tests.
